WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(1.0 * sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS zone_count
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT step1.healtheval, step1.avg_ratio, step1.zone_count,
         step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg AS difference
  FROM step1
  JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(zone_count), AVG(difference) FROM step3
